name: Toolproof
description: Trust grades for MCP servers and APIs. Scans the model-visible surface — tool names, descriptions, schemas, prompts, resources, instructions, outbound hosts — and returns a letter grade with 16 rules covering hidden instructions, invisible characters, exposed secrets, unsafe defaults and missing auth. Every verdict is an ed25519-signed passport, verifiable offline. No accounts, no keys.

api.signature: ed25519 over canonical JSON; public key at /api/v1/pubkey

differentiator: Paid by nobody it scans. A trust layer that takes money from the tools it grades is worthless, so neutrality is the business model, not a promise.
